name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in 3 instalments of Rs 2,000 every four months, paid straight to the bank account
other_conditions: Cultivable land must be in the family's name; Only one member per family (husband, wife, minor children) gets the benefit; Not eligible: institutional landholders, serving or retired government employees (except MTS/Group D), pensioners getting Rs 10,000 or more per month, income tax payers, constitutional post holders, registered professionals like doctors, engineers, lawyers and CAs; Aadhaar-linked bank account and eKYC required
documents: Aadhaar; Bank passbook; Land records; Mobile number
apply_steps: Go to pmkisan.gov.in and click New Farmer Registration; Enter Aadhaar, state and captcha; Fill land and bank details; Submit and wait for state verification; Complete eKYC to keep getting payments

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
benefit: Free cashless hospital treatment up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals
other_conditions: Families are chosen using SECC 2011 deprivation criteria; All citizens aged 70 and above are separately eligible regardless of income (Vay Vandana card); No limit on family size or age for covered families
documents: Aadhaar; Ration card; Mobile number
apply_steps: Check eligibility at mera.pmjay.gov.in or call 14555; Visit the Ayushman Mitra at an empanelled hospital or CSC; Verify identity with Aadhaar or ration card; Get your Ayushman card; Use the card for cashless treatment

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
benefit: Cash assistance for delivering in a government or accredited facility: in states like Maharashtra Rs 700 (rural) or Rs 600 (urban) per delivery
other_conditions: In high-performing states such as Maharashtra only BPL, SC and ST women qualify; Limited to 2 live births; Delivery must be in a government or accredited private facility; Paid as a one-time DBT after delivery
documents: Aadhaar; Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card; BPL card or caste certificate; Bank account details
apply_steps: Register your pregnancy with the ASHA, ANM or Anganwadi worker; Get the MCP card and attend antenatal check-ups; Deliver at a government or accredited facility; Submit documents at the facility; Receive the cash in your bank account

name: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (Maharashtra)
benefit: Free cashless treatment up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year at network hospitals
other_conditions: For families holding yellow, orange, Antyodaya or Annapurna ration cards, and white-card farmer families in notified districts; Must be a Maharashtra resident; Treatment only at empanelled network hospitals and for listed procedures
documents: Ration card; Aadhaar or other photo ID
apply_steps: Visit a network hospital and meet the Arogyamitra; Show your ration card and photo ID; Hospital sends pre-authorisation; Get cashless treatment once approved

name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin
benefit: Rs 1.2 lakh (plains) or Rs 1.3 lakh (hilly and difficult areas) to build a pucca house, plus Rs 12,000 for a toilet and wage days for construction labour
other_conditions: Beneficiaries picked from the SECC 2011 list and Awaas+ survey; Family must not own a pucca house; Not eligible: government employee in family, income tax payer, family with motorised vehicle or fishing boat; Household income should not exceed Rs 15,000 per month
documents: Aadhaar; Job card; Bank account; Land or plot details
apply_steps: Get your household surveyed through the Gram Panchayat or Awaas+ app; Check your name in the permanent wait list; Get Gram Sabha approval and sanction; Geo-tag each stage of construction; Receive instalments in your bank account

name: PM Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
benefit: Central assistance of Rs 2.5 lakh for building or buying a house, or interest subsidy on a home loan up to Rs 8 lakh (max subsidy about Rs 1.8 lakh)
other_conditions: Covers EWS (up to Rs 3 lakh), LIG (Rs 3-6 lakh) and MIG (Rs 6-9 lakh) households; Family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India; Four components: Beneficiary-led construction, Affordable housing in partnership, Affordable rental housing, Interest subsidy; The original PMAY-U closed in 2024 and 2.0 replaced it
documents: Aadhaar; Income proof or self-declaration; Bank account; Land ownership papers (for self-construction); Passport photo
apply_steps: Visit pmay-urban.gov.in or your urban local body; Choose the component that suits you; Fill the application with Aadhaar details; Get your documents verified by the local body; Receive sanction and subsidy

name: Atal Pension Yojana
benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000 or 5,000 (your choice of slab) from age 60 until death; the same pension is paid to the spouse after the subscriber's death
other_conditions: Must have a savings bank or post office savings account; Not a member of any statutory social security scheme; Anyone who is or has been an income tax payer cannot join from 1 October 2022 (earlier joiners may continue); Contributions are auto-debited monthly, quarterly or half-yearly; Pension starts at age 60
documents: Savings bank or post office account; APY registration form; Aadhaar
apply_steps: Visit your bank branch or post office (or your bank's online channel); Fill the APY registration form; Choose a pension slab of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 per month; Choose contribution frequency and consent to auto-debit from your savings account

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefit: Rs 2 lakh life insurance cover on death for any reason, for a premium of Rs 436 per year auto-debited from your account
other_conditions: Must hold a savings account in a participating bank or post office; Only one account per person can be used to join; Cover must be renewed every year and can continue up to age 55 if you joined before 50; Premium is auto-debited from your account with your consent
documents: Savings bank or post office account with KYC up to date; PMJJBY enrolment form with auto-debit consent
apply_steps: Visit your bank branch or BC point, your bank's website, or your post office; Fill the PMJJBY enrolment form; Give consent for yearly auto-debit of the Rs 436 premium; Renew every year (or choose the long-term continue option)

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
benefit: Rs 2 lakh on accidental death or full disability and Rs 1 lakh on partial disability, for a premium of Rs 20 per year auto-debited from your account
other_conditions: Must have a bank account with an Aadhaar number linked to it; Premium is auto-debited from your account (the only payment mode); Enrolment form to be given to the bank every year before 1 June
documents: Aadhaar number linked to bank account; Bank account details; Nominee name
apply_steps: Visit your bank branch; Submit the simple PMSBY form with your nominee's name before 1 June; Give consent for auto-debit of the Rs 20 premium; Repeat the enrolment every year

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
benefit: Monthly pension from the Centre of Rs 200 (age 60-79) or Rs 500 (age 80 and above); states often add their own top-up
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a BPL household as per state list; Central share is paid through the state, which may increase the amount
documents: Age proof; BPL card or certificate; Aadhaar; Bank account details; Passport photo
apply_steps: Get the application form from the Gram Panchayat, municipality or tehsil office; Fill it and attach documents; Submit for verification; District authority sanctions the pension; Pension is paid to your bank account

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
benefit: Free LPG connection (financial support of Rs 2,050 for a 14.2 kg cylinder connection) in the name of the woman of the household, plus a targeted subsidy on refills
other_conditions: Adult woman from a poor household such as BPL, SC/ST, PMAY, AAY, tea garden or forest dweller families; No other LPG connection in the household; KYC and bank account required; Refill subsidy depends on the current government order
documents: Aadhaar; Ration card or BPL proof; Bank account details; Passport photo; KYC form
apply_steps: Download the KYC form from pmuy.gov.in or collect it from an LPG distributor; Fill it and attach documents; Submit to the nearest LPG distributor; Get verified; Receive the connection

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: Government savings account for a girl child with a high interest rate (set quarterly, 8.2 percent in 2025), tax-free interest and maturity at 21 years
other_conditions: Girl must be under 10 years when the account is opened; Account is opened by a parent or guardian; Maximum 2 accounts per family (3 if twins or triplets); Minimum deposit Rs 250 and maximum Rs 1.5 lakh per year; Deposits for 15 years; Partial withdrawal of up to 50 percent after age 18 for education or marriage
documents: Girl's birth certificate; Parent or guardian ID and address proof; Aadhaar; Passport photos
apply_steps: Go to a post office or authorised bank; Fill the Sukanya Samriddhi account form; Submit the documents; Make the first deposit of at least Rs 250; Collect the passbook

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
benefit: Rs 5,000 in two instalments for the first living child, paid to the mother's bank account (Rs 6,000 if the second child is a girl)
other_conditions: For pregnant and lactating women for first live birth, and second child if a girl; Not for women already getting similar maternity benefit from government or PSU jobs; Must register pregnancy and complete health check-ups
documents: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card; Aadhaar; Bank or post office account; Husband's Aadhaar; ID proof
apply_steps: Register at the Anganwadi centre or health facility; Fill the application form with documents; Submit the second form after 6 months of pregnancy and one check-up; Submit the third form after birth registration and first immunisation; Money is sent to your account

name: PM Mudra Yojana
benefit: Collateral-free business loans up to Rs 20 lakh: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishor (Rs 50,000 to 5 lakh), Tarun (Rs 5 to 10 lakh), Tarun Plus (Rs 10 to 20 lakh)
other_conditions: For non-farm income generating small businesses in manufacturing, trading or services; Loans given by banks, NBFCs and MFIs; Tarun Plus is open only to those who repaid an earlier Tarun loan
documents: Aadhaar; PAN; Business proof or address proof; Bank statements; Passport photo; Quotation for machinery if applicable
apply_steps: Pick the loan category that fits your need; Apply at a bank, NBFC or MFI or through udyamimitra.in; Fill the application and attach documents; Lender checks and sanctions; Loan is disbursed

name: PM SVANidhi
benefit: Collateral-free working capital loans of Rs 15,000, then Rs 25,000, then Rs 50,000 on timely repayment, with 7 percent interest subsidy and digital transaction cashback
other_conditions: Must have a certificate of vending, letter of recommendation from the urban local body, or be in the vendor survey; Must have been vending on or before 24 March 2020; Next loan is available only after repaying the earlier one
documents: Aadhaar; Vending certificate or letter of recommendation; Mobile number linked to Aadhaar; Bank account
apply_steps: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or go to a CSC or bank; Submit vendor details and documents; Urban local body verifies; Bank sanctions the loan; Loan is credited to your account

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefit: Training with Rs 500 per day stipend, Rs 15,000 toolkit incentive and collateral-free loans of Rs 1 lakh then Rs 2 lakh at 5 percent interest, plus PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card
other_conditions: Must work with hands and tools in one of the 18 listed traditional trades; Self-employed at time of registration; Not availed similar credit schemes (PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra) in past 5 years; Only one member of a family can register; Government employees not eligible
documents: Aadhaar; Mobile number linked to Aadhaar; Bank account; Trade details
apply_steps: Register at a CSC or on pmvishwakarma.gov.in with Aadhaar biometric; Fill in trade and bank details; Get verified by the Gram Panchayat or urban local body and district committee; Receive certificate and ID card; Join training and claim toolkit and loan

name: Stand-Up India
benefit: Bank loan of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore to set up a first-time (greenfield) business
other_conditions: Must be a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe entrepreneur and/or a woman entrepreneur; Only for new greenfield business in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied activities; For companies and firms at least 51 percent stake must be held by an SC, ST or woman entrepreneur; Must not be a defaulter to any bank
documents: Aadhaar; PAN; Caste certificate (for SC/ST applicants); Project report; Address proof; Bank statements
apply_steps: Register on standupmitra.in or visit a bank branch; Prepare a project report; Submit the loan application with documents; Bank checks and sanctions the composite loan; Loan is disbursed

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC students
benefit: Monthly maintenance allowance and reimbursement of compulsory fees for SC students studying after Class 10
other_conditions: Student must be studying a recognised course after Class 10; Parents' annual income must not exceed Rs 2.5 lakh; Amounts depend on course group and whether the student stays in a hostel
documents: Caste certificate; Income certificate; Aadhaar; Previous year marksheet; Admission proof; Bank account details
apply_steps: Register on scholarships.gov.in or your state portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in in Maharashtra); Fill the online application; Upload documents; Submit and get the form verified by your institute; Scholarship is paid to your bank account

name: MGNREGA (replaced by VB-G RAM G from 1 July 2026)
benefit: 125 days of guaranteed wage employment per year for every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work
other_conditions: MGNREGA was repealed on 1 July 2026 and replaced by the Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act 2025; e-KYC verified MGNREGA job cards stay valid until new Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Cards are issued; Adult members must volunteer for unskilled manual work
documents: Aadhaar; Job card; Bank account; Passport photo
apply_steps: Apply to the Gram Panchayat for a job card; Submit an application for work; Get work allotted; Wages are paid to your bank account

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
benefit: Rs 1,500 per month by direct bank transfer to eligible women
other_conditions: Scheme is still active as of late 2025 and 2026 reports; Must be a Maharashtra resident; Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned or destitute woman, or one unmarried woman per family; Aadhaar-linked bank account; No family member who is an income tax payer or government employee; Family should not own a four-wheeler (tractor allowed); Annual eKYC is mandatory to keep receiving payments; Portal reportedly not taking fresh applications
documents: Aadhaar; Maharashtra domicile proof or ration card; Income certificate or yellow or orange ration card; Bank passbook; Passport photo
apply_steps: Apply through the Ladki Bahin portal ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in or Anganwadi centre when registration is open; Fill the form with Aadhaar details; Upload documents and submit; Complete annual eKYC on the portal; Check payment status on the portal
